tags.name: HRMS V1
tags.description: Developers who are responsible for integrating BIPO HRMS with third-party applications (clients) can utilize the API (Application Programming Interface) offered by BIPO HRMS to extract data from Employee/Leave/Attendance/Payroll modules. This document serves as a guide for developers seeking assistance in developing the integration. Before you can use the API, you will need to make sure you have a few things in place: - Create a [Postman account](https://identity.getpostman.com/signup) if you haven't already done so. You will also need to install the Postman Client on your local machine. - Import the Postman Collection by clicking "Run In Postman" button located at the top right corner. - You will need access to a working BIPO Demo instance, such as DemoSEA. - For BIPO Employee, you can download the Environment file from [BIPO Wiki](https://biposvc.sharepoint.com/sites/HRMSWIKI/SitePages/System-API.aspx) and import into Postman. Please see [here](https://learning.postman.com/docs/getting-started/importing-and-exporting/importing-data/#import-postman-data) on how to import Environment file. Reference API Portal Introduction [here.](https://biposvc.sharepoint.com/sites/Product2/_layouts/15/stream.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FProduct2%2FShared%20Documents%2FIntegration%20Lobby%2FA%2DI%2FBIPO%20%28internal%29%2FIntegration%2FTraininig%20Videos%2FHRMS%20API%20Portal%20Introduction%20Workshop%2D20230831%5F150003%2DMeeting%20Recording%2Emp4&ga=1&referrer=StreamWebApp%2EWeb&referrerScenario=AddressBarCopied%2Eview%2Ec5031c4e%2Dd3b4%2D4ea6%2D925d%2D408d2a0ec15f) - If you're not from BIPO, you can reach out to BIPO employee that you are currently working with. Note to BIPO PMs, please advise CN clients to use non-corporate network to access BIPO-Portal. We currently do not possess a formal benchmark for API consumption rates or capping. Nevertheless, as long as developers refrain from unduly abusing API requests, which is primarily not the case, it remains acceptable. Please note that basic knowledge of Postman is required in order to use the API. If you're new to Postman, you can learn the basics [here](https://learning.postman.com/docs/getting-started/sending-the-first-request/). **Notes:** - GetList and GetListItem are designed to pull table details. For simplicity sake, we will only document based on GetListItem - API log captures relevant data related to API requests, responses, errors, and other events that occur during the API's operation. If you are from BIPO, you can check API log. Enable System Config first in order to record API log. - At Upsert API, multiple objects are allowed to upsert in single API request. Each key fields must be identical for each object in the array. - Best practice is consolidate all updates into one object of one API request rather than putting them in different object. - Before attempting to use any UPDATE method, PMs/developers are requested to engage with the product team first. - Attachments cannot be extracted from GetList and GetListItem API. - HTTPS is used for encryption of API which is the same for web and mobile access. - To nulltify a Date/Datetime field, set it as NULL instead of "" (empty string) - Reach out to api support team for any feedback ([api.support@biposervice.com](https://))

HRMS V1 > System > File Management
tags.description:
BIPO HRMS supports file management via API. Files are attached to an existing record (e.g. a leave or claim request) using that record's ID, which is returned by the record's own Export API.

Each file has its own `RecordID`. Use File List to get it, then download or delete the file.

Note: Each API must be enabled for the Web API user under Controller "BIPOAttachmentController" (methods GetFiles, GetFile, UploadFile, DeleteFile).

Note: Errors return HTTP 200 with `"ok": false` and a message, e.g. `{"ok": false, "msg": "File not found."}`.

tags.name: HRMS V1 > System > View
tags.description: The **GetView** API is a feature that allows users to extract data from the database through pre-configured **SQL Views**, without directly accessing the database. This provides both flexibility and control for data extraction, particularly useful in integration scenarios. Why we should use GetView? **Secure Data Access**: GetView only expose necessary data through controlled SQL views, reducing security risks. **Flexible Integration**: User can query filtered data via API without custom development. GetView accept parameters like EmployeeCode, CompanyCode, ect to filter data dynamically. **User Friendly**: End users don't need to know the internal schema of the database - they interact with friendly "View Names". If you don't have access to create SQL Views, contact your Project Manager to setup SQL views. If you have access to create SQL Views, go to System > Utility > SQL View Screen and create SQL View. Please make sure to use optimized SQL Command. - Ensure it's filtered appropriately with WHERE clauses - Use parameter placeholders (e.g., @CompanyCode) and blank field handling - Avoid overly complex joins or non-performant Lastly, user can call the API with proper JSON body.

tags.description:
Response Structure of Import and Delete API: The API returns a structured response indicating the processing result of each record submitted in the request payload. Records are categorized into **validRecords** and **invalidRecords** based on validation and processing outcomes. ``` json { "data": { "key": "", "validRecords": [ { "key": "", "message": "" } ], "invalidRecords": [ { "key": "", "errorMessage": "" } ] }, "errorCode": "", "errors": [ "" ], "messages": [ "" ] } ``` ### **Field Descriptions:** `data` (object) Contains the processing results grouped by record status. | **Field** | **Type** | **Description** | | --- | --- | --- | | key | string | Defines the composite key fields used to uniquely identify each record in the request data. Example: "EmployeeCode;DateStart" | | validRecords | array | List of records that were successfully validated and processed. | | validRecords.key | string | **Composite key value derived from the request.
Example: "000002;2025-01-01;BIPO" | | validRecords.message | string | Result message
Example: "Added", "Updated", "Deleted" | | invalidRecords | array | List of records that failed validation or processing. | | invalidRecords.key | string | **Composite key value derived from the request.
Example: "000002;;BIPO" | | invalidRecords.message | string | Description of the validation or processing error.
Example: "Mandatory Date Start must not be empty." | | errorCode | string | System-level error code | | errors | array | Summary messages describing the overall import result.
Example: "1 record(s) imported. 1 failed record(s)". | | messages | array | Successful message
Example: "10 record(s) imported." | **Key Mapping Rule: > **The key value in both** **`validRecords`** **and** **`invalidRecords`** **is derived from the fields specified in** **`data.key`**, using the corresponding values from each record in the request **`data`**. - Fields are concatenated using a semicolon (`;`) - If a key field value is missing, it will be represented as empty | **Request** | **Key return in Response** | | --- | --- | | "EmployeeCode": "000002",
"DateStart": "2025-01-01T00:00:00",
"CompanyCode": "BIPO" | "000002;2025-01-01;BIPO" |

tags.name: Lark/FeiShu (2026Q3)
tags.description:
BIPO is integrated with FeiShu (飞书)/Lark, the leading Office Automation (OA) platform from China. The strength of the integration is to enable BIPO HRMS as a backend engine to enable submit/approve workflow request within FeiShu/Lark's "Approval Center" without the need to login to separate portal. It improves user experience drastically and allow workflow automation within client's FeiShu/Lark's tenant or mobile app.

Requests approved within FeiShu/Lark is automatically synchornize into BIPO HRMS for further payroll processing or report compilation.

Supported FeiShu/Lark Features:

- SSO:
    
    - Employee login BIPO's ESS via FeiShu/Lark User Profile
        
    - Multi-tenants (Client subscribed to more than one FeiShu/Lark tenants and all integrated to single BIPO HRMS instance)
        
- Integrated Workflows: Submission/Approval within FeiShu/Lark app
    
    - Appraisal Confirmation
        
    - Claim
        
    - Clocking
        
    - Daily Attendance
        
    - Exit Request
        
    - Leave
        
    - Overtime
        
    - Shift Amendment
        

> **Remark:**  
[Deployment guides](https://biposvc.sharepoint.com/:w:/r/sites/Product2/Shared%20Documents/Integration%20Lobby/J-P/Lark_FeiShu/Deployment%20Guide.docx?d=w7024ccb4fc544ef49968e99e585b1a15&csf=1&web=1&e=8v9miJ) is currently restricted to BIPO team only. If you are interested, do [reach out to us](https://www.biposervice.com/company/contact-us).  
Target Release: 2026Q3

tags.name: Webhook (2026Q2)
tags.description: Webhook currently is under BETA. Employee movements can be synchronize to external application in realtime via webhook. Example: **Deployment Steps:** 1. Copy webhook URL from external application e.g. [https://domain.app/flows/trigger/](https://dus.up.railway.app/flows/trigger/9e73ccae-4fb1-46b6-858f-9c48891002a6)xxx 2. Login HRMS 3. Create new "App Connection" 1. Type = "Webhook" 2. URL = [https://domain.app/flows/trigger](https://domain.app/flows/trigger) (domain + path before dynamic value 'xxx') 4. Create new "Event Hook" 1. Tick "Enable" 2. Point to App Connection (created in step 3 above) 3. Navigate to "Scope" tab 1. Set Action to "Add"/"Modify"/"Delete" (determine which event to trigger synchronization to external app) 2. Set "HMAC Secret" if applicable (for auth purpose) 3. Scope (current support "EmployeeProfile" only) note: It covers all employee movements: Employee Master, Org Structure, Salary, Spare Fields etc 4. Webhook (insert "xxx", copied from step 1 above) 5. Done > **Remark:** Webhook is currnetly benchmarking by developer team. Target Release: 2026Q2

tags.name: Workday (2026Q1)
tags.description:
BIPO currently supports Global Payroll Connect (GPC) and five core functional modules. Each module is act as an independent integration and can be setup separately. Once the modules are deployed, it's expected to exchange payroll relevant data seemlessly between Workday and BIPO HRMS.

The supported modules/features:

1. Global Payroll Hub (GPH): Get a Workday-delivered, holistic view of payroll processing status, tax information, and metrics across different pay groups and countries in real time in Workday. Actuall processing status are retrieve from BIPO HRMS.
    
2. Additional Payroll Data (APD): Additional payroll data or country-specific payroll data is data which is required for payroll processing, specific for a country, and not supported natively in Workday. Hence a realtime form is render within Workday. Upon submission the details are able to sync to BIPO HRMS in realtime and sync to employee statutory details.
    
3. Data Changes on Demand (DCoD): BIPO capture employee movements (delta) from Workday via REST APIs (e.g. New Hire, Termination, Change of Salary etc) in order to process payroll in BIPO.
    
4. External Payroll Documents (ExPD): A tool to upload payroll-related  
    documents generated by BIPO HRMS into Workday, including payslips, tax documents, and other payroll documents.
    
5. External Payroll Results (ExPR): Enable loading of payroll results from BIPO HRMS into Workday as list of earnings and deductions.
    

> Remark:  
Target Release: 2026Q1

tags.name: User & Access Provision
tags.description:
These APIs create and maintain users, user roles and role access in BIPO. They are built for the Butter application integration only.

Note: A Butter licence is required.

Note: The Web API user that calls these APIs must have the User Code `#BUTTER_USERS` (at this moment). Any other Web API user is not granted these APIs automatically.

Note: To get a user set up for this, ask Product. It needs special approval from the Product team.

Note: Set up in this order: User Role, then User Role Access, then User.

tags.name: Error Handling
tags.description:
Sample error responses returned by the API and how to read them.

Most errors return a JSON body in this shape:

| **Field** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| data | Always `null` when an error occurs. |
| errorCode | Reference code, when one applies. |
| errors | List of messages that explain what to correct. |
| messages | Additional information. |

| **HTTP Status** | **Meaning** |
| --- | --- |
| 400 | The request could not be processed. Correct the request using the message in `errors`. |
| 401 | Not authenticated, or not authorized for the endpoint. Get a new token or ask your administrator for access. |

post.description:
Upload a file into BIPO and attach it to an existing record. Send the file as a link (`AWS`, BIPO downloads it, e.g. from an AWS S3 pre-signed URL) or as Base64 content in the request (`BASE64`). See the examples for each.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| AttachmentSource | String | Yes | Where the file is attached. See the table below. |
| RequestID | String | Yes | ID of the record the file belongs to, taken from that record's Export API (see table below). |
| EmployeeCode | String | No | Employee the file belongs to. Maximum 60 characters. |
| Source.Type | String | Yes | `AWS` = BIPO downloads the file from a URL. `BASE64` = file content is sent in the request. |
| Source.Url | String | Conditional | Required when Source.Type is `AWS`. Full http/https link, e.g. an AWS S3 pre-signed URL. The file name is taken from the link. |
| Source.FileName | String | Conditional | Required when Source.Type is `BASE64`. Include the file extension, e.g. `Sample.pdf`. |
| Source.Content | String | Conditional | Required when Source.Type is `BASE64`. File content encoded as Base64. |

| AttachmentSource | Attachment's destination | RequestID from |
|---|---|---|
| EmployeeAttachment | Personnel > Employee > Attachment | AttachmentID |
| ContractEmployeeDetail | Personnel > Employee > Contract > Detail | AttachmentID |
| EmployeeCertificate | Personnel > Employee > Certificate | AttachmentID |
| EmployeeFamily | Personnel > Employee > Family (Vietnam only) | AttachmentID |
| AcknowledgementAttachment | Personnel > Acknowledgement | AttachmentID |
| IdentityConfirmationDocumentAttachment | Personnel > My Number Request (Japan only) | IdentityConfirmationDocument |
| JoinRequestAttachment | Life Cycle > Onboarding > Attachment | AttachmentID |
| JoinRequestCertificate | Life Cycle > Onboarding > Certificate | AttachmentID |
| ResignRequest | Life Cycle > Offboarding Exit Request | AttachmentRequestID |
| ContractRenewal | Life Cycle > Contract Renewal | AttachmentID |
| ContractRequest | Life Cycle > Contract Request | AttachmentID |
| ExitInterviewRecord | Life Cycle > Exit Interview | AttachmentRequestID |
| PersonalDeclaration | Life Cycle > Personal Declaration | AttachmentRequestID |
| ClockingRequest | Attendance > Clocking Request | RequestID |
| OTAuthRequest | Attendance > OT Authorization | RequestID |
| ShiftChangeRequest | Attendance > Shift Change | RequestID |
| Leave | Leave > Leave Record | RequestID |
| LeaveCF | Leave > Leave Carry Forward | RequestID |
| ClaimRecord | Claim > Claim Record | AttachmentID |
| ClaimRequest | Claim > Claim Request | RequestID |

Note: The record must already exist. A RequestID that is not found is rejected and nothing is stored.

Note: File size and file type follow the system's attachment upload settings (maximum 100 MB).

Note: The response returns the new file's `RecordID`.

Note: For `AWS`, the URL must be reachable from the BIPO server and still valid when the API is called.

post.description:
Delete employee probation details from BIPO.

**This deletes every probation cycle on file for that employee.** There is no way to target a single cycle, because `Sequence` is not part of the delete key.

To rebuild a corrected history, delete the employee's cycles and re-insert them in order via UPSERT (which re-derives `Sequence` from 1 upwards).

This is a hard delete — the rows are physically removed.

### Request fields

| Field | Type | Mandatory | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `InterfaceCode` | string | **Yes** | Always `BIPO-EMP-PD` |
| `EmployeeCode` | string(16) | **Yes** | Delete key. Every cycle for this employee is removed |
| `Sequence` | int | — | **Not a key here.** Sending it does not narrow the delete |

> **Differs from HRMS V2.** V2 deletes by `EmployeeCode` + `Sequence`, removing one specific cycle.

post.description:
Add an employee probation cycle in BIPO.

**This operation is insert-only.** Every record submitted always creates a **new** probation cycle for that employee — there is no update-in-place or correction capability. Sending the same `EmployeeCode` twice produces two cycles, not one amended cycle.

**Prerequisite:** the `UseProbationDetail` system parameter must be switched on.

### Request fields

| Field | Type | Mandatory | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `InterfaceCode` | string | **Yes** | Always `BIPO-EMP-PD` |
| `EmployeeCode` | string(16) | **Yes** | Key. The field must be present in the payload |
| `ProbationPeriod` | int | No | Interval value. Needed to calculate `DateProbationDue` when that field is omitted |
| `ProbationPeriodType` | string(1) | No | Period unit, e.g. `M` for months. Needed for the same calculation |
| `DateProbationDue` | date | No | **Honoured when supplied** — stored exactly as given. Omit it (or send `null`) and the system calculates it as the later of the previous cycle's due date or the employee's join date, plus `ProbationPeriod`. Supply it to load historical cycles accurately, where recalculating from the employee's current join date would not reproduce the original value |
| `DateConfirm` | date | No | Confirmation date |
| `ProbationRating` | string(150) | No | Free text |
| `ProbationReason` | string(150) | No | Free text |
| `Sequence` | int | — | **Not accepted.** Always system-derived as `MAX(Sequence) + 1` for that employee; a submitted value is overwritten |

> **Differs from HRMS V2.** V2 always calculates `DateProbationDue` and ignores any client-supplied value, and additionally enforces `ProbationPeriod` (1–9999) and `ProbationPeriodType` as mandatory. Only V1 accepts a supplied due date.

Insert and update employee salary details

\* Additional salary components could be extend in BIPO portal and UPSERT directly via API (SFNXX, SFCXX, SALXX, SFRXX)  
  
  \* Setup Path: Setup > Setting > Spare Field > Select 'Salary Field'  
  SFN01 – SFN30: Best for general numeric data (30 slots available)  
  
  \* Setup Path: Setup > Setting > Spare Field > Select 'Salary Variable'  
  SAL01 – SAL05: Specifically for "Salary Variables" (5 slots available).  
  SFR01 – SFR10: Use these for text-based salary remarks or codes (10 slots available).  
  SFC01 – SFC05: Additional character fields for short labels (5 slots available).

post.description:
Insert and update contract types in BIPO.

Keyed on `ContractTypeCode`: the record is inserted if the code does not exist, otherwise updated in place. Multiple rows may be sent in one call.

### Request fields

| Field | Type | Mandatory | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `InterfaceCode` | string | **Yes** | Always `BIPO-CTL` |
| `ContractTypeCode` | string(16) | **Yes** | Key. Rejected if empty |
| `ContractTypeName` | string(60) | No |  |
| `CountryCodes` | string | No | Comma-separated list (e.g. `SG,MY,HK`), or `\*` for all countries |
| `Obsolete` | string(1) | No | `Y` / `N` soft-retire flag. Setting `Y` marks the row retired; it does not delete it |

> **Differs from HRMS V2.** V2 also enforces `ContractTypeName` as mandatory. V1 accepts a row without it.

post.description:
This api is to add an employee probation cycle in BIPO.

**This operation is insert-only.** Every record submitted always creates a **new** probation cycle for that employee — there is no update-in-place or correction capability. Sending the same `EmployeeCode` twice produces two cycles, not one amended cycle.

### Request fields

| Field | Type | Mandatory | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `InterfaceCode` | string | **Yes** | Always `BIPO-EMP-PD` |
| `EmployeeCode` | string(16) | **Yes** | Key |
| `ProbationPeriod` | int | **Yes** | Must be between **1 and 9999**. |
| `ProbationPeriodType` | string(1) | **Yes** | Period unit, e.g. `M` for months. See the exception below |
| `DateConfirm` | date | No | Confirmation date |
| `ProbationRating` | string(150) | No | Free text |
| `ProbationReason` | string(150) | No | Free text |
| `DateProbationDue` | date | — | **Not accepted.** Always calculated from the employee's join-date reference plus `ProbationPeriod`; a submitted value is ignored |
| `Sequence` | int | — | **Not accepted.** Always system-derived as `MAX(Sequence) + 1` for that employee |

> **Differs from HRMS V1.** V1 accepts a client-supplied `DateProbationDue` and stores it as given, so historical cycles can be loaded there with their original due dates — not possible here. V1 also does not enforce `ProbationPeriod` / `ProbationPeriodType`.

This API is used to delete an existing leave request in the system. It works for normal leave and for leave-with-expiry requests.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| InterfaceCode | String | Yes | Must be `BIPO-LVR` |
| RecordID | String (GUID) | Yes | Unique ID of the leave request to delete |

Note: `RecordID` is the only value needed. Get it from the **Leave Record - LIST** response, or from the response of **Leave Record - UPSERT** when `RespectField` is `R`.

Note: A cancelled request is a separate record from the original request. Delete each one with its own `RecordID`.

Note: To change the leave-with-expiry balance itself, contact your BIPO consultant. The balance can be read with **Leave With Expiry - LIST** but cannot be written or deleted through the API.

post.description:
This API is used to delete user roles from BIPO.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| InterfaceCode | String | Yes | `BIPO-URL` |
| Data | Array | Yes | List of records to delete. Each record carries `UserRoleCode`. |
| UserRoleCode | String | Yes | User Role Code to delete. |

Note: A role that is still assigned to a user cannot be deleted. The record is returned under `invalidRecords` with `Cannot delete this record as it has been used in table User.`

Note: Deleting a role also deletes its role access.

Note: A code starting with `#` is used by BIPO itself and cannot be deleted.

Note: A code that does not exist is returned under `invalidRecords` with `Record could not be found.`

Note: This API is for the Butter application integration only. A Butter licence is required.

This API is used to delete users from BIPO.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| InterfaceCode | String | Yes | `BIPO-USR` |
| Data | Array | Yes | List of records to delete. Each record carries `UserCode`. |
| UserCode | String | Yes | User Code to delete. |

Note: A code starting with `#` is used by BIPO itself and cannot be deleted.

Note: A user that is already used elsewhere in BIPO cannot be deleted. The record is returned under `invalidRecords` with the reason.

Note: A code that does not exist is returned under `invalidRecords` with `Record could not be found.`

Note: This API is for the Butter application integration only. A Butter licence is required.

Roster_-_LIST_Time-Based_Roster_Version_.summary: Roster - LIST (Time-Based / Roster Version 2, split shift)

post.description:
This api is to extract an employee's resolved roster for a date range.

Unlike a raw roster table read, this returns **one row for every date in the range**, with the shift resolved the same way the on-screen Roster page resolves it: a manual roster change for that date if one exists, otherwise the employee's default Work Calendar shift. A date with no resolvable shift is still returned, with `Shift1`/`Shift2` as `null` — it is never silently omitted.

**Read-only** — this interface code has no Import or Delete counterpart.

### Request fields

| Field | Type | Mandatory | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `InterfaceCode` | string | **Yes** | Always `BIPO-RO` |
| `EmployeeCode` | string(16) | **Yes** | Exactly **one** employee per call. A comma-separated list is rejected. The employee must also fall within the calling API user's **Attendance read access range** |
| `RosterDateFrom` | date | **Yes** | Start of range, e.g. `2026-09-01` |
| `RosterDateTo` | date | **Yes** | End of range. Must not exceed `RosterDateFrom` + **1 calendar month** |

### Response fields

One object per date in the range.

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `EmployeeCode` | string(16) |  |
| `RosterDate` | string | `yyyy-MM-dd` |
| `IsHoliday` | bool | True when the date is a public holiday for that employee |
| `Shift1` | object | The shift for the date; `null` if none resolves |
| `Shift2` | object | Second session on a split-shift date; otherwise `null` |
| `UpdateBy` | string | Populated **only** where a manual roster change exists for that date; `null` when the shift came from the default Work Calendar |
| `UpdateOn` | string | As above. `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss` |

#### Shift object

Shape depends on the client's **Roster Version** configuration.

| Field | Type | Roster Version | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ShiftCode` | string | 1 (Shift-Based) only | Absent in Time-Based, where times are held per date rather than per shift code |
| `WorkStatus` | string | Both |  |
| `NormalStartTime` | string | Both | `HH:mm` |
| `NormalEndTime` | string | Both | `HH:mm` |
| `CostRefCode` | string | Both |  |
| `Break` | array | Both | Array of `{ BreakStart, BreakEnd, BreakHours }`. Empty when the Break Display configuration hides breaks |

### Error responses

| Message | When |
| --- | --- |
| `EmployeeCode does not exist.` | `EmployeeCode` is blank |
| `The number of selected employees must not exceed the limit of 1.` | More than one employee code is sent |
| `No permission to access.` | The employee is outside the API user's **Attendance read access range**. Checked before the dates |
| `RosterDateFrom does not exist.` / `RosterDateTo does not exist.` | A date is missing |
| `Invalid entry of RosterDateFrom.` / `Invalid entry of RosterDateTo.` | A date is not a valid date |
| `RosterDateTo must not exceed 1 months from .` | The range is longer than 1 calendar month |

Daily_Attendance_-_LIST_Validation_error.summary: Daily Attendance - LIST (Validation error: range exceeds 1 month)

post.description:
This api is to extract employees' daily attendance records for a date range.

Returns one row per employee per day that has a daily attendance record — the same record shown on the Daily Attendance screen after processing. Days with no record are not returned.

**Read-only** — this interface code has no Import or Delete counterpart.

### Request fields

| Field | Type | Mandatory | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `InterfaceCode` | string | **Yes** | Always `BIPO-DL` |
| `EmployeeCode` | string(16) | Conditional | One employee. Either `EmployeeCode` or `EmployeeCodes` must be sent |
| `EmployeeCodes` | array of string | Conditional | Up to **30** employees per call by default. The limit can be changed in System Configuration **Base > Interface >** **`DailyAttendanceAPIMaxEmployee`** (1–999) |
| `ClockDateFrom` | date | **Yes** | Start of range, e.g. `2026-10-01` |
| `ClockDateTo` | date | **Yes** | End of range. Must not be earlier than `ClockDateFrom`, and must not exceed `ClockDateFrom` + **1 calendar month** |
| `Fields` | array of string | No | The columns to return, e.g. `["EmployeeCode", "ClockDate", "ClockIn"]`. Not case-sensitive. Omit to return all fields |

### Response fields

One object per employee per day, sorted by `EmployeeCode` then `ClockDate`. With no `Fields`, every row carries all standard fields (about 330). The main ones:

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `EmployeeCode` | string(16) |  |
| `ClockDate` | string | `yyyy-MM-ddT00:00:00` |
| `CalendarCode` | string | Work Calendar applied for the day |
| `ShiftCode` / `ShiftCode2` | string | Shift for the day; `ShiftCode2` on a split-shift day |
| `WorkStatus` | string | e.g. `W` work day |
| `Holiday` | string | `Y` / `N` |
| `ClockIn` / `ClockOut` | string | `HH:mm`. `null` when there is no clocking |
| `ShiftHours` | decimal | Hours |
| `WorkHoursActual`, `WorkHoursPaid` | decimal | Hours |
| `LatenessActualMinutes`, `UndertimeActualMinutes` | decimal | Minutes |
| `OTActual`, `OTAuthorised` | decimal | Overtime hours, actual and authorised |
| `Absent` | string | `Y` / `N` |
| `LeaveCode` | string | Leave taken on the day |
| `ApprovalStatus` | string |  |
| `Locked`, `Endorsed` | number | `0` = no |
| `ProcessOn`, `LastProcessOn` | string | `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss`. When the day was last processed |
| `OT01`–`OT99`, `TE01`–`TE99`, `DFC01`–`DFC20`, `OTR01`–`OTR10` | decimal / string | Numbered fields. What each one holds depends on your site's attendance setup. `OT` and `TE` go higher where your licence allows |

### Error responses

| Message | When |
| --- | --- |
| `Either EmployeeCode or EmployeeCodes must be entered.` | No employee is sent, or `EmployeeCodes` is empty |
| `The number of selected employees must not exceed the limit of 30.` | More employees are sent than the limit (30 by default) |
| `Mandatory ClockDateFrom must not be empty.` / `Mandatory ClockDateTo must not be empty.` | A date is missing |
| `Invalid entry of ClockDateFrom.` / `Invalid entry of ClockDateTo.` | A date is not a valid date |
| `ClockDateTo must be after or equal to ClockDateFrom.` | The range runs backwards |
| `ClockDateTo must not exceed 1 months from 2026-10-01.` | The range is longer than 1 calendar month |

**Note:**

- Errors return **HTTP 400** with the message in `errors`.
    
- Only employees within the API user's **Attendance read access** are returned. Others are left out without an error.
    
- An employee code that does not exist returns an empty list, not an error.
    
- If both `EmployeeCode` and `EmployeeCodes` are sent, only employees in both are returned. Send one or the other.
    
- A name in `Fields` that is not a valid field is skipped without an error.
    
- A response holds at most **10,000 rows**. Rows above that are cut off without an error, so keep the employee list and date range small.
    
- Without `Fields`, each row is large. For regular feeds, list only the fields you need.
    
- The API user and its linked HRMS user must both be granted interface code `BIPO-DL`.

List_a_request_synced_from_an_external_s.summary: List a request synced from an external system (ExternalRequestID)

post.description:
This API is used to extract leave requests from BIPO. It covers normal leave and leave-with-expiry requests.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| InterfaceCode | String | Yes | Must be `BIPO-LVR` |
| EmployeeCodes | Array of String | No | Only return requests of these employees |
| DateFrom | Date (yyyy-mm-dd) | No | Only return requests from this leave date |
| DateTo | Date (yyyy-mm-dd) | No | Only return requests up to this leave date |
| ApprovalDateFrom | Date (yyyy-mm-dd) | No | Only return requests approved from this date |
| ApprovalDateTo | Date (yyyy-mm-dd) | No | Only return requests approved up to this date |
| Fields | Array of String | No | Columns to return. Leave out to return all columns |

Note: Always send a filter (`EmployeeCodes` or a date range) so the response stays small.

Note: `ApprovalStatus` in the response shows where the request stands, for example `A` = Approved, `PA` = Pending Approval, `C` = Cancelled.

Note: `RecordID` in the response is the value to use for amend, approve, cancel and delete in **Leave Record - UPSERT** and **Leave Record - DELETE**.

Note: `ExternalRequestID` in the response is the reference your own system sent when the request was created. It is not unique, so match on `RecordID` when you need exactly one request.

List_leave-with-expiry_balance_of_an_emp.summary: List leave-with-expiry balance of an employee

post.description:
This API is used to extract the leave-with-expiry balance of employees from BIPO. Each row is one credit with its entitled, taken and encashed days and the date it expires.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| InterfaceCode | String | Yes | Must be `BIPO-LWE` |
| EmployeeCodes | Array of String | No | Only return the balance of these employees |

Note: This API is for reading only. The balance cannot be written or deleted through the API.

Note: Leave requests taken from this balance (create, cancel, delete) are handled by **Leave Record - UPSERT** and **Leave Record - DELETE** with `BIPO-LVR`, using the leave code of the leave-with-expiry type.

Draft_claim_with_refused_claims_in_the_s.summary: Draft claim with refused claims in the same call

post.description:
This api is to insert and update claims in BIPO. Each object in `Data` is one claim, and its receipts go in `Records`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| RecordID | String | Conditional | BIPO ID of the claim. Leave blank to create a new claim. To update, approve or cancel a claim, send the RecordID returned when the claim was created. |
| ExternalRequestID | String | No | Your own reference for the claim. |
| EmployeeCode | String | Conditional | Required when creating a claim. Cannot be changed on an existing claim. |
| ClaimCode | String | Conditional | Required when creating a claim. Cannot be changed on an existing claim. |
| ClaimDate | Date | No | Claim date (yyyy-MM-dd). |
| CurrencyCode | String | No | Claim currency. Cannot be changed on an existing claim. |
| ApprovalStatus | String | No | New claim: blank or `A` = Approved, `PS` = Pending Submission (draft). Existing claim: `A` approves a draft, `C` cancels an approved claim. Leave out to keep the current status. |
| Remarks | String | No | Claim remarks. |
| Records | Array | Conditional | Receipts of the claim. A new claim needs at least 1 receipt. Leave out when you only change claim fields, approve or cancel. |
| Records[].RecordID | String | Conditional | Leave blank to add a new receipt. To update a receipt, send its RecordID (from Claim Record Details - LIST). |
| Records[].ExternalRecordID | String | No | Your own reference for the receipt. |
| Records[].ExpenseCode | String | No | Expense of the receipt. |
| Records[].ReceiptDate | Date | No | Receipt date (yyyy-MM-dd). |
| Records[].ReceiptNo | String | No | Receipt number. |
| Records[].ReceiptAmount | Decimal | No | Receipt amount. Must be greater than 0. |
| Records[].CurrencyCode | String | No | Receipt currency. |
| Records[].ExchangeRate | Decimal | No | Leave out to use the rate from Currency Exchange. |
| Records[].Remarks | String | No | Receipt remarks. |

Note:
- The response returns the claim `RecordID` in `key`. Keep it to update, approve, cancel or delete the claim later.
- Only the receipts listed in `Records` are changed. Receipts not listed are kept as they are.
- A claim type with Multiple Receipt = No accepts 1 receipt only.
- Claims are saved as an admin entry. An approved claim does not go through the approval workflow.
- The claim type's own rules (for example mandatory fields) are checked the same way as on the admin Claim Record screen.
- Spare fields can also be sent on the claim or on a receipt when they are enabled in Field Selection.
- Each claim in `Data` is processed on its own. One refused claim does not stop the others; see `invalidRecords` in the response.

Sync_a_leave_request_from_an_external_sy.summary: Sync a leave request from an external system (ExternalRequestID)

post.description:
This API is used to create, amend, approve and cancel leave requests in BIPO. It also covers leave-with-expiry requests (for example Leave Code LWE01), and it is the API to use when you sync leave requests from an external system into BIPO.

A leave request can be identified in two ways, chosen with `RespectField`:

| RespectField | Identifies a leave request by | What you can do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| R **(Recommended)** | `RecordID` (single key) | Blank `RecordID` creates a new request. A supplied `RecordID` amends, approves or cancels that request. |
| K (default when `RespectField` is omitted) | `EmployeeCode` + `LeaveCode` + `DateStart` + `DateEnd` (legacy) | Create a new request or cancel an existing one. It cannot amend. |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| InterfaceCode | String | Yes | `BIPO-LVR` |
| RespectField | String | No | `R` or `K`. Default is `K`. |
| RecordID | String (GUID) | Conditional | Leave request identifier. Required when `RespectField` = R and you amend, approve or cancel a request. Leave it blank to create a new request. Not used when `RespectField` = K. |
| EmployeeCode | String | Conditional | Unique employee identifier. Required when you create a request, or when `RespectField` = K. Also send it when you approve a request. |
| LeaveCode | String | Conditional | Leave Code. Required when you create a request, or when `RespectField` = K. Also send it when you approve a request. |
| DateStart | Date (yyyy-mm-dd) | Conditional | Start date of the leave request. Required when you create a request, or when `RespectField` = K. |
| DateEnd | Date (yyyy-mm-dd) | Conditional | End date of the leave request. Required when you create a request, or when `RespectField` = K. |
| HalfStart | String | Conditional | Required if Leave UnitType = D (Day). First half of the day (`"AM"` or `"PM"`). Also required when you cancel in K style. |
| HalfEnd | String | Conditional | Required if Leave UnitType = D (Day). Second half of the day (`"AM"` or `"PM"`). Also required when you cancel in K style. |
| TimeStart | String (HH:mm) | Conditional | Leave start time. Required if Leave UnitType = H (Hour). |
| TimeEnd | String (HH:mm) | Conditional | Leave end time. Required if Leave UnitType = H (Hour). |
| ApprovalStatus | String | Conditional | Send `"C"` to cancel a leave request. Leave it out in every other case. A new request is approved automatically. |
| ExternalRequestID | String | No | Your own reference number for the leave request, kept in BIPO and returned by Leave Record - LIST. |
| DateReference | Date (yyyy-mm-dd) | Conditional | Only for leave types that ask for a reference date (for example marriage or child-related leave). |
| ReferenceName | String | Conditional | Only for leave types tied to a family member or a named reference (for example marriage or child-related leave). |
| Remarks | String | No | Additional remarks |

Note: The response returns the `RecordID` of every imported leave request only when `RespectField` = R. Keep it: it is the key for a later amend, approve, cancel or delete.

Note: `ExternalRequestID` is not unique. BIPO does not stop two leave requests from carrying the same value, so store the returned `RecordID` next to your own reference.

Note: Cancelling adds a separate cancellation record and marks the leave request as cancelled. A request that is already cancelled cannot be cancelled again.

Note: This API cannot create a leave request that waits for approval. A new request is approved as soon as it is created.

Note: To approve a leave request that is waiting for approval, send its `RecordID`, `EmployeeCode` and `LeaveCode` and leave `ApprovalStatus` out. The API user must have write access to that employee.

Note: The saved examples below show create (Recommended), amend, cancel, approve, sync from an external system, leave-with-expiry, the legacy multi-key style and the common error messages.

post.description:
This API is used to create or update user roles in BIPO.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| InterfaceCode | String | Yes | `BIPO-URL` |
| UserRoleCode | String | Yes | User Role Code, up to 60 characters. Letters and numbers only. A new code creates a role; an existing code updates it. A new code cannot start with `#`. |
| UserRoleName | String | Yes | User Role name, up to 60 characters. |
| MenuAccessCode | String | Yes | Menu Access Code. Must already exist in BIPO. |
| CompanyCodes | String | No | Company Codes the role can access, separated by commas. Leave it empty or send `*` for all companies. |

Note: The response lists each record as `Added` or `Updated`. In a batch, a record that fails is returned under `invalidRecords` with its reason, and the other records are still saved (HTTP 200). Example reasons: `Invalid Menu Access.`, `Mandatory Name must not be empty.`

Note: When a new role is created for a Menu Access that includes Payroll, and the Payroll application is licensed, BIPO also adds a default Payroll access row for the role.

Note: This API is for the Butter application integration only. A Butter licence is required.

| WriteAccess | String | No | Write access condition, in BIPO's data access condition format. Replaces the saved value. |

| LeaveCodeAccess | String | No | Leave Codes, separated by commas. Added to the saved list. |
| ClaimCodeAccess | String | No | Claim Codes, separated by commas. Added to the saved list. |
| PayGroupAccess | String | No | Pay Groups, separated by commas. Added to the saved list. |
| AppendPTTypes | String | No | Codes separated by commas. Added to the saved list. |
| ShowCompleteStatus | String | No | Codes separated by commas. Added to the saved list. |
| EFormCodes | String | No | eForm Codes, separated by commas. Added to the saved list. |

Note: `UserRoleCode` and `System` together identify the record. A new pair adds a row; an existing pair updates it.

Note: For the fields marked "Added to the saved list", this API only adds codes. It cannot remove codes that are already saved. Sending `*` means all.

Note: There is no DELETE for role access. Deleting the User Role removes its access.

Note: A role created for a Menu Access that includes Payroll already has a default Payroll access row, so an Import for `Payroll` updates that row.

Note: This API is for the Butter application integration only. A Butter licence is required.

This API is used to create or update users in BIPO.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| InterfaceCode | String | Yes | `BIPO-USR` |
| UserCode | String | Yes | User Code, up to 60 characters. A new code creates a user; an existing code updates it. |
| UserName | String | Yes | User name, up to 60 characters. |
| UserType | String | Yes | `M` = Master, `A` = Admin, `U` = User. |
| CountryCodes | String | Yes | Country/Region Codes, separated by commas. |
| UserRoleCode | String | Yes | User Role Code. Must already exist in BIPO. |
| ParentUserCode | String | No | Parent User Code. Must not be the same as `UserCode`. Only used when `UserType` = U. |
| EmployeeCode | String | No | Employee linked to the user. Two users cannot share the same Employee Code. |
| Email | String | No | Email address. Must be a valid email address, and two users cannot share the same one. |
| NTUserName | String | No | Windows login name. |
| MobileCountryCode | String | No | Mobile country code. |
| MobileNo | String | No | Mobile number. |

Note: A new user is created with a random password and must change it on first login, so the user cannot log in until the password is reset or the user signs in through single sign-on. Passwords cannot be sent through this API.

Note: The number of users is limited by the user licences. Over the limit, the record is refused with `Maximum no of records exceeds {0} user licences.`

Note: In a batch, a record that fails is returned under `invalidRecords` with its reason, and the other records are still saved (HTTP 200). Example reasons: `Invalid User Role.`, `Mandatory Name must not be empty.`

Note: This API is for the Butter application integration only. A Butter licence is required.

This API retrieves the configured **interface mapping values** maintained in the **Interface Mapping** Screen.

It is used in system integrations where the **source system** and **BIPO HRMS** have **different data formats**, ensuring consistent data translation between both systems.

post.description:
This API is used to extract list of **employee attachments** data (e.g., resume, profile photo, etc.). It retrieves attachment from TblEmployeeAttachment table, joined with TblAttachment.

Note: this API does not return the actual file or binary content. In order to get actual file (in binary format), use the **FileID** returned from this API in the **GetAttachment** API.

It can also filter with EmployeeCode parameter for a specific employee. If EmployeeCode is not provided, the API returns attachments uploaded in the past 30 days.

Roster_-_LIST_Time-Based_Roster_Version_.summary: Roster - LIST (Time-Based / Roster Version 2, split shift)

post.description:
Extract an employee's resolved roster for a date range.

Unlike a raw roster table read, this returns **one row for every date in the range**, with the shift resolved the same way the on-screen Roster page resolves it: a manual roster change for that date if one exists, otherwise the employee's default Work Calendar shift. A date with no resolvable shift is still returned, with `Shift1`/`Shift2` as `null` — it is never silently omitted.

**Read-only** — this interface code has no UPSERT or DELETE counterpart.

### Request fields

| Field | Type | Mandatory | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `InterfaceCode` | string | **Yes** | Always `BIPO-RO` |
| `EmployeeCode` | string(16) | **Yes** | Exactly **one** employee per call. A comma-separated list is rejected. Send the code exactly as stored, including upper/lower case |
| `RosterDateFrom` | date | **Yes** | Start of range, in `yyyy-MM-dd` format, e.g. `2026-09-01` |
| `RosterDateTo` | date | **Yes** | End of range, in `yyyy-MM-dd` format. Must not exceed `RosterDateFrom` + **1 calendar month**, and must not be earlier than `RosterDateFrom` |

### Response fields

One object per date in the range.

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `EmployeeCode` | string(16) |  |
| `RosterDate` | string | `yyyy-MM-dd` |
| `IsHoliday` | bool | True when the date is a public holiday for that employee |
| `Shift1` | object | The shift for the date; `null` if none resolves |
| `Shift2` | object | Second session on a split-shift date; otherwise `null` |
| `UpdateBy` | string | Populated **only** where a manual roster change exists for that date; `null` when the shift came from the default Work Calendar |
| `UpdateOn` | string | As above. `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss` |

#### Shift object

Shape depends on the client's **Roster Version** configuration.

| Field | Type | Roster Version | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ShiftCode` | string | 1 (Shift-Based) only | Absent in Time-Based, where times are held per date rather than per shift code |
| `WorkStatus` | string | Both |  |
| `NormalStartTime` | string | Both | `HH:mm`. `null` on a rest or off day |
| `NormalEndTime` | string | Both | `HH:mm`. `null` on a rest or off day |
| `CostRefCode` | string | Both |  |
| `Break` | array | Both | Array of `{ BreakStart, BreakEnd, BreakHours }`. Empty when the shift has no break, or (Time-Based) when the Break Display configuration hides breaks |

### Errors

Business-rule rejections (unknown employee, missing date, range over 1 month) return **HTTP 200** with the error message as a plain JSON string, not an object.

**Note:** Use `yyyy-MM-dd` for both dates. Other formats may be read differently — for example, `01/09/2026` is read as 9 January.

**Note:** If `RosterDateTo` is earlier than `RosterDateFrom`, the API returns an empty list rather than an error.

**Note:** A rest or off day still returns a `Shift1` object, with its `WorkStatus` and `null` times. `Shift1` is `null` only when no shift applies to the date.

post.description:
Extract employees' daily attendance records for a date range.

Returns one row per employee per day that has a daily attendance record — the same record shown on the Daily Attendance screen after processing. Days with no record are not returned.

**Read-only** — this interface code has no UPSERT or DELETE counterpart.

### Request fields

| Field | Type | Mandatory | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `InterfaceCode` | string | **Yes** | Always `BIPO-DL` |
| `EmployeeCode` | string(16) | Conditional | One employee. Either `EmployeeCode` or `EmployeeCodes` must be sent |
| `EmployeeCodes` | array of string | Conditional | Up to **30** employees per call by default. The limit can be changed in System Configuration **Base > Interface > `DailyAttendanceAPIMaxEmployee`** (1–999). An empty array counts as not sent |
| `ClockDateFrom` | date | **Yes** | Start of range, in `yyyy-MM-dd` format, e.g. `2026-10-01` |
| `ClockDateTo` | date | **Yes** | End of range, in `yyyy-MM-dd` format. Must not be earlier than `ClockDateFrom`, and must not exceed `ClockDateFrom` + **1 calendar month** |
| `Fields` | array of string | No | The columns to return, e.g. `["EmployeeCode", "ClockDate", "ClockIn"]`. Not case-sensitive. Omit to return all fields |

### Response fields

One object per employee per day, sorted by `EmployeeCode` then `ClockDate`. With no `Fields`, every row carries all standard fields (about 375). The main ones:

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `EmployeeCode` | string(16) |  |
| `ClockDate` | string | `yyyy-MM-ddT00:00:00` |
| `CalendarCode` | string | Work Calendar applied for the day |
| `ShiftCode` / `ShiftCode2` | string | Shift for the day; `ShiftCode2` on a split-shift day |
| `WorkStatus` | string | e.g. `W` work day |
| `Holiday` | string | `Y` / `N` |
| `ClockIn` / `ClockOut` | string | `HH:mm`. `null` when there is no clocking |
| `ClockTime1` … `ClockTime9` | string | Individual clock times, in order |
| `ShiftHours`, `BreakHours` | decimal | Hours |
| `WorkHoursActual`, `WorkHoursPaid` | decimal | Hours |
| `LatenessActualMinutes`, `UndertimeActualMinutes` | decimal | Minutes |
| `OTActual`, `OTAuthorised` | decimal | Overtime hours, actual and authorised |
| `Absent` | string | `Y` / `N` |
| `LeaveCode`, `LeaveHours` | string, decimal | Leave taken on the day |
| `ApprovalStatus` | string |  |
| `Locked`, `Endorsed` | number | `0` = no |
| `ProcessOn`, `LastProcessOn` | string | `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fff`. When the day was last processed |
| `OT01`–`OT99`, `TE01`–`TE99`, `DFC01`–`DFC20`, `OTR01`–`OTR10` | decimal / string | Numbered fields. What each one holds depends on your site's attendance setup. |

### Errors

Business-rule rejections (missing date, missing employee, range over 1 month, too many employees, unknown parameter) return **HTTP 200** with the error message as a plain JSON string, not an object.

**Note:**

- Use `yyyy-MM-dd` for both dates. Other formats may be read differently .
    
- An employee code that does not exist returns an empty list, not an error.
    
- If both `EmployeeCode` and `EmployeeCodes` are sent, only employees in both are returned. Send one or the other.
    
- A name in `Fields` that is not a valid field is skipped without an error. If none of the names are valid, all fields are returned. Any other unknown request field is rejected.
    
- The API user must be granted interface code `BIPO-DL`.
    
- Without `Fields`, each row is large. For regular feeds, list only the fields you need.

This API retrieves the **field and caption pairs** maintained in the **Interface Mapping Caption** Screen for one mapping key.

It is used with **Interface Mapping - LIST**, which returns mapping values named by caption, to see which mapping field (F01-F99) each caption stands for.

### **Endpoint Parameters**

| **Field** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| MappingKey | Mandatory. The unique key defined in Interface Mapping Caption Screen identifying the mapping set. |

Only fields with a caption are returned, sorted by field. A mapping key that does not exist, or has no captions, returns an empty list.

post.description:
This API retrieves the configured **interface mapping values** maintained in the **Interface Mapping** Screen.

It is used in system integrations where the **source system** and **BIPO HRMS** have **different data formats**, ensuring consistent data translation between both systems.

Each row uses the captions as field names. Only fields with a caption are returned. Use Interface Mapping Caption to see which mapping field each caption stands for.

### **Endpoint Parameters**

| **Field** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| MappingKey | Mandatory. The unique key defined in Interface Mapping Caption Screen identifying the mapping set. |

This api is to extract PGP Encryption from BIPO.

'EncryptionCode' is mandatory in request body.

System will return the original plain text value for Password/Passphrase fields.

get.description:
To extract Payroll Reports that are already included into Scheduled Report from BIPO.

The display will be similar with the Report Preview from BIPO.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}}/cmnapi/ScheduledReport/Log/Files/Download/{RecordID}  
Can get the {RecordID} from **\[Post Scheduled Report - Item:** **recordID\]**.

servers.description: Your BIPO HRMS base URL. The default is a sample; replace it with your own tenant's base URL.

baseurl.description: Host and path of your BIPO HRMS tenant, without the https:// prefix (for example shde999.bipocloud.com/abc).
